stories.title: Visite du pape : au Stade de France, Léon XIV célèbre le « combat » pour « la foi », qui « n’utilise pas les armes de la violence, du mépris ou de l’oppression »

en.title: Pope's visit: At the Stade de France, Leo XIV celebrates the "struggle" for "faith", which "does not use the weapons of violence, contempt or oppression"
en.summary: Nearly 80,000 young people filled the Stade de France on Friday to welcome the head of the Catholic Church. The diverse crowd gathered to share a religious experience for the evening.

stories.title: Visite de Léon XIV : de l’Élysée au Stade de France, revivez la première journée du pape à Paris

en.title: Leo XIV's visit: from the Élysée to the Stade de France, relive the pope's first day in Paris
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV attended a prayer vigil at the Stade de France during his first day visiting France. The event reflects growing religiosity among young Catholics in France, where adult baptisms have increased over five years.

stories.title: Zinédine Zidane réussit son baptême du feu en Turquie pour son premier match à la tête de l’équipe de France, malgré la blessure de Kylian Mbappé

en.title: Zinédine Zidane succeeds in his baptism by fire in Turkey for his first match leading the French team, despite Kylian Mbappé's injury
en.summary: France defeated Turkey 1-0 on Friday under new coach Zinédine Zidane, with the winning goal scored by Kylian Mbappé. The captain sustained a knee injury and will miss the next three matches.

stories.title: Réception à l'Elysée, déambulation à Paris, bain de foule au Stade de France... Revivez les moments marquants de la première journée de la visite du pape Léon XIV

en.title: Reception at the Elysée, stroll through Paris, crowd bath at the Stade de France... Relive the highlights of Pope Leon XIV's first day of visit
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV began a four-day visit to France with an eventful schedule on Friday, including meetings at the Elysée, public appearances in a popemobile, a Mass at Notre-Dame, and a vigil at the Stade de France.

stories.title: Dans un stade de France enflammé, Léon XIV a appelé les jeunes à la sainteté et aux vocations

en.title: In a blazing French stadium, Pope Leon XIV called young people to holiness and vocations
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV addressed 80,000 people at a stadium event featuring singing, exchanges, and prayers, alternating between energetic and contemplative moments.

stories.title: L’éditorial de Laurence de Charette : « Pape Léon XIV au Stade de France, pour que la jeunesse ait la vie »

en.title: Editorial by Laurence de Charette: "Pope Leon XIV at the Stade de France, so that youth may have life"
en.summary: An editorial reflects on Pope Leon XIV's message and presence as offering spiritual resonance to young people amid modern existential concerns facing Western civilization.

stories.title: Léon XIV : le pape accueilli en rock star au Stade de France

en.title: Leon XIV: the pope welcomed as a rock star at the Stade de France
en.summary: Eighty thousand young Catholics gathered at the stadium for an event mixing gospel and contemporary music, giving Pope Leon XIV a celebrity-style reception as he arrived in his papal vehicle.

stories.title: "Vous portez dans votre cœur un immense désir de liberté" : le pape Léon XIV s'adresse aux jeunes depuis le Stade de France

en.title: "You carry within your heart an immense desire for freedom": Pope Leon XIV addresses young people from the Stade de France
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV spoke to young people at the stadium, thanking them for their courage, presence, and faith, and referred to them as the saints of France.

stories.title: Léon XIV en visite à Paris : le pape en rock star au stade de France

en.title: Pope Leon XIV visits Paris: the pope as rock star at the Stade de France
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV, an American pontiff, began a four-day visit to France on September 25, traveling from Paris to Metz via Lourdes to promote multilateralism in response to Trump-related tensions.

stories.title: "Que son message réveille la France" : l'espoir des jeunes catholiques devant le pape Léon XIV

en.title: "May his message awaken France": the hope of young Catholics facing Pope Leon XIV
en.summary: Young Catholics gathered on Friday in Paris streets to see Pope Leon XIV, with members of the Anuncio evangelization group among them, seeking to share their faith during this historic papal visit.

stories.title: 🔴 En direct : le pape acclamé au Stade de France lors d’une grande veillée réunissant 80 000 jeunes catholiques

en.title: 🔴 Live: Pope acclaimed at the Stade de France during a major vigil bringing together 80,000 young Catholics
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV was acclaimed at the Stade de France during a large gathering of 80,000 young Catholics.

stories.title: Le pape accueilli dans une ambiance survoltée au Stade de France, pour une grande veillée avec des jeunes

en.title: Pope welcomed in an electrified atmosphere at the Stade de France for a major vigil with young people
en.summary: Around 80,000 young people waited for hours at the Stade de France to see Pope Leon XIV, accompanied by pop-praise and gospel musical performances.

stories.title: OPINION. « La troisième voie économique est-elle encore possible ? », par Julien Aubert, président de l’Institut Valmy

en.title: OPINION. "Is a third economic path still possible?", by Julien Aubert, president of the Valmy Institute
en.summary: A former Republican politician proposes an economic alternative between neoliberalism and socialism, drawing on Gaullist tradition.

stories.title: En Occitanie, le nombre de fonctionnaires territoriaux a explosé en cinq ans

en.title: In Occitania, the number of territorial civil servants has surged in five years
en.summary: A regional audit office released a report on September 25 examining the growth of municipal staff between 2019 and 2024, identifying causes and recommending measures to optimize payroll amid declining public finances.

stories.title: Le Royaume-Uni crée son escadron de combat orbital

en.title: The United Kingdom creates its orbital combat squadron
en.summary: The UK has announced the creation of a military squadron dedicated to protecting satellites as part of its new space strategy, following similar moves by other armed forces to safeguard space assets.

stories.title: SES lance le chantier d’une nouvelle usine de satellite

en.title: SES launches construction of a new satellite factory
en.summary: Luxembourg-based telecommunications operator SES has begun construction of a new satellite manufacturing facility, with its groundbreaking ceremony held on September 24.

stories.title: Présidentielle : l’IA, ce sujet qui divise les candidats

en.title: Presidential election: AI, a subject that divides candidates
en.summary: Presidential candidates and their representatives gathered in Marseille for a debate on artificial intelligence, presenting differing political perspectives on regulation, sovereignty, and investment.
